**Sprinto** is your trusted partner in data security. We are unwavering in our commitment to protecting your data and ensuring privacy. Our rigorous security posture is underpinned by Sprinto technology, industry-leading best practices, and adherence to globally-regarded security and privacy frameworks.

As a practice, we go beyond compliance to proactively identify and mitigate risks, continuously enhancing our security measures. This not only safeguards your data but also helps you meet your regulatory obligations effectively.

This Security Posture provides a detailed overview of our data security and privacy measures, including our commitment to risk management, best practices, and continuous improvement.

Kombo is an opt-in subprocessor used only when a customer enables one of Sprinto’s supported LMS integrations: Workday, LinkedIn Learning, or Udemy Business. Kombo provides a unified API that enables Sprinto to connect to the customer’s LMS and synchronize approved training data, including users, courses, enrollments, learning progress, and completion information.

For customers using the Kombo Technologies GmbH service arrangement, data is processed and stored primarily in Germany using Google Cloud infrastructure in Germany and EU regions, including Ireland. Limited support or technical access may occur from other locations as permitted by the applicable data processing agreement. Kombo is not used unless the customer enables one of the supported LMS integrations.
